prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied ocean texture into one high-resolution SQUARE seamless repeatable game terrain tile, ideally 1536x1536. Preserve this reference's vivid turquoise and sapphire blue palette, elevated top-down perspective, calm sunny mood. Pixel-art style matching an elegant island simulation: sharp discrete pixel clusters, tiny angular wavelets and thin white glints, subtle submerged azure pebble-like caustics, beautifully controlled clear detail. It will occupy only 384x384 game world units, not the whole island. Make all four edges tile seamlessly; uniform even water across the whole frame with small non-directional detail, no large repeating diagonals, no big bright central patch, no vignette or directional gradient. Only open sea: absolutely no shoreline, land, islands, rocks above water, dock, boats, characters, text, grid, frame, interface, blur or depth of field. Output only the crisp seamless water tile.
